description: This file is a PHP script used to test the Redmine API integration within the TestLink project. It sets up multiple Redmine site configurations, initializes a Redmine object, and constructs an XML payload to create a new issue in Redmine via the API.

classes.name: redmine
classes.description: A class (likely from the included redmine-rest-api.php) that interfaces with the Redmine REST API, allowing operations such as creating issues.

methods.name: addIssueFromSimpleXML
methods.description: Creates a new Redmine issue using a SimpleXMLElement representing issue data.
